<!-- Code generated by xgen. DO NOT EDIT. -->
<!-- Source: xgen/screens/src/authoring/blocks/guide.ts -->
<!--
  One stop of a product tour: the element being explained and a callout beside it with a title, a sentence, the
  position in the tour and the buttons. Axes: placement (below, above, end: the callout sits beside the target),
  tone, density.
-->
<script lang="ts">
export type TourCalloutProps = {
  id: string;
  title: string;
  text: string;
  target: string;
  position: string;
  skip: string;
  next: string;
  placement?: "below" | "above" | "end";
  tone?: "default" | "muted";
  density?: "default" | "compact";
};
</script>

<script setup lang="ts">
import Block from "../primitives/block/block.vue";
import Button from "../primitives/button/button.vue";
import Group from "../primitives/group/group.vue";
import Stack from "../primitives/stack/stack.vue";
import Text from "../primitives/text/text.vue";
import SectionFrame from "../components/section-frame.vue";
import { cn } from "../utils";

const {
  id,
  title,
  text,
  target,
  position,
  skip,
  next,
  placement = "below",
  tone = "default",
  density = "default",
} = defineProps<TourCalloutProps>();
</script>

<template>
  <SectionFrame :id="id" :title="title" :tone="tone" :density="density">
    <Block
      tag="div"
      :class="cn(
        'flex gap-4',
        (
          (placement as string) === 'end' ? 'flex-col items-start md:flex-row md:items-center'
          : (placement as string) === 'above' ? 'flex-col-reverse items-start'
          : 'flex-col items-start'
        )
      )"
      data-testid="tour"
      :data-placement="placement"
    >
      <Button variant="outline" size="default" type="button" class="inset-ring-foreground" data-testid="tour-target">
        {{ target }}
      </Button>
      <Stack
        gap="4"
        align="stretch"
        :class="cn('w-full max-w-sm', 'rounded bg-card inset-ring inset-ring-border', 'p-4', 'shadow-md')"
        role="group"
        :aria-label="title"
        data-testid="tour-callout"
      >
        <Text size="xs" class="text-muted-foreground">
          {{ position }}
        </Text>
        <Text size="base" weight="semibold">
          {{ title }}
        </Text>
        <Text size="sm" class="text-muted-foreground">
          {{ text }}
        </Text>
        <Group gap="2" justify="end">
          <Button variant="ghost" size="sm" type="button">
            {{ skip }}
          </Button>
          <Button variant="default" size="sm" type="button">
            {{ next }}
          </Button>
        </Group>
      </Stack>
    </Block>
  </SectionFrame>
</template>
